title: poreTransport operation
description:
The PROPS BENCH of the DSPM-DE transport law at IMPOSED permeate fluxes: the same TransportModel the spiral-wound module marches, built through the same factory, the same `transportParameters` reader and the same wall kernel, handed J_v instead of closing J_w = A_w (dP - dpi) -- the way NanoFiltran (Geraldes & Alves 2008) takes it. Publishes per J_v point p and per ion species c_wall__p

, c_perm__p

(mol/m3), Rreal__p

= 1 - c_perm/c_wall and Robs__p

= 1 - c_perm/c_bulk, and permeateCharge_max. Witness nanofiltran01_dspmde_reference; gate check_nanofiltran_reference holds it to NanoFiltran. The film is built from the `polarisation {}` policy directly (not buildPolarisation), because the feed is declared as salts and DSPM-DE hands the kernel each ion's own z and D.

membrane.title: Membrane record
membrane.description: A membrane record (data/standards/assets or the case's constant/assets) carrying a poreModel {} block.

transport.title: Transport law
transport.description: Only `DSPM-DE` honours an imposed J_v; any other word refuses.  Absent = DSPM-DE.

transportParameters.title: Transport-law parameters
transportParameters.description: Parameters a transport law reads for itself (the block batchDiafilter hands its law too).  `gelPolarisation` reads `gel { solute <gel-forming solute>; c_gel <kg/m3>; sieving { <solute> <S>; ... }; source "..."; }` -- S in [0, 1) for EVERY solute, and `source` says where c_g and S come from.  `DSPM-DE` reads `poreSolver { method finiteDifference; nodes <n>; grading <beta>; wallClosure porePermeate | solutionDiffusion; }`, `hindrance DechadilokDeen2006;`, `activity wallDavies | ideal | bulkOverPoreDavies;` and `bulkDielectric <eps>;` -- and nothing else (an unknown key or word refuses).

poreSolver.title: DSPM-DE pore solver
poreSolver.description: How DSPM-DE crosses the pore: it is SOLVED (DEV.md 4c C138; the default since 2026-10-24, the only method since C142).  Absent = `method finiteDifference;` on 101 nodes, uniform, with `wallClosure porePermeate`, each default announced.  The extended Nernst-Planck equations on `nodes` grid points across the pore (faces included), electroneutrality at every node and zero current, and -- in the SAME Newton -- the film's interface balance at the wall and the water flux J_w = A_w (dP - dpi): one Newton per station on the declared block-tridiagonal structure with an analytic Jacobian.  NanoFiltran (Geraldes & Alves 2008) is the reference it is compared with.  `nodes` defaults to 101, announced.  `grading` (beta of a tanh map toward both faces, 0..6) defaults to 0, the uniform grid: grading toward the faces was MEASURED not to help (the steep region of a mixed-counter-ion pore is an interior front).  `wallClosure`: `porePermeate` (default) closes the multi-ionic wall with the solved pore's own permeate; `solutionDiffusion` closes it with the salts' solution-diffusion B_s, a permeate the pore does not make.  `method closedForm;` (the default until 2026-10-24) is RETIRED and refuses by name with its reason: it did not solve the pore, and with the corrected K_d its transmission tends to K_c > 1 at low Peclet number.  An unknown method word refuses.

hindrance.title: DSPM-DE hindrance factors
hindrance.description: Absent = `DechadilokDeen2006`, the one pair (announced as the default): K_d = H/Phi (lambda <= 0.95; 0.984((1-lambda)/lambda)^2.5 above) and K_c their rational fit -- the cross-section-averaged pair (Ind. Eng. Chem. Res. 45 (2006) 6953).  H, the Dechadilok-Deen polynomial, is Phi K_d.  `legacy` (H itself taken as K_d, so the steric partition counted twice in diffusion; the default until 2026-10-24) REFUSES by name, saying why.

activity.title: DSPM-DE activity treatment
activity.description: Absent = `wallDavies`: Davies at the bulk ionic strength on the feed face, the permeate ideal.  `ideal`: every activity coefficient 1.  `bulkOverPoreDavies`: gamma_bulk/gamma_pore at BOTH faces, Davies (log10) with A(eps, T) = 1.82483e6 (eps T)^-1.5 -- eps_b on the solution side, eps_p on the pore side, the pore gammas at the pore's end nodes; evaluated inside the station's Newton on the answer's own ionic strengths.

bulkDielectric.title: Bulk dielectric constant
bulkDielectric.description: The solution's relative dielectric constant in the Born term and in A(eps_b).  Absent = SolventProperties::epsWater(T) (78.45 at 25 C).

feedMolPerM3.title: Feed salts [mol/m3]
feedMolPerM3.description: One entry per SALT component of the package (each with `dissociatesTo`), its bulk molar concentration in mol/m3; the law decomposes the salts into ions.

k_film.title: Constant film coefficient
k_film.description: k for every ion, in place of `massTransfer {}` (NanoFiltran simulates "no polarisation" with 10 m/s).

massTransfer.title: Film-coefficient correlation
massTransfer.description: The cell's correlation, evaluated per ion on the ion's own D0. `StirredCell` (Sh = a (omega r^2/nu)^b Sc^c, k = Sh D/r; Bowen et al. 1997 defaults 0.23/0.567/0.33) needs `omega` and `radius`; `SchockMiquel` (a spacer channel) needs `velocity` and `hydraulicDiameter`. `viscosity` and `density` are REQUIRED (nu = mu/rho).

polarisation.title: Polarisation policy
polarisation.description: The film's POLICY, one block whichever way k arrives (a correlation or a bare `k_film`); declaring these words inside massTransfer {} refuses. `suctionCorrection`: GeraldesAfonso2006 (Xi = phi + (1 + 0.26 phi^1.4)^-1.7), filmTheory (the default: Xi = phi + phi/(e^phi - 1)) or none. `ionCoupling`: electroneutral (the multi-ionic model of Geraldes & Afonso 2007 -- each ion's k on its own D0, one interface potential gradient fixed by electroneutrality at the wall; needs >= 2 charged solutes) or none (the default, announced on an ion-declared feed).
